reason: I already know to order grilled and skip the fries, so an app telling me what to eat feels like a solution to a problem I don't have. Fifty dollars a year for something I'd check once a week on a Friday isn't worth it to me.
objection: I already know to order grilled and skip the fries, so I don't see what it would add to what I already do.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me that a grilled dish I order every time, like the salmon, actually comes with something on it that I didn't expect, I'd pay for that.
